question: Which of the following shifted its Andhra Pradesh regional office to Vijayawada, inaugurating the new premises on 16 June 2025?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** shifted its Andhra Pradesh regional office to **Vijayawada** and inaugurated the new premises on **16 June 2025**.
 
• The decision to relocate the office aligns with the reorganization of Andhra Pradesh and the establishment of **Amaravati** as its capital region, which led to Vijayawada becoming a major administrative hub.
 
• The RBI regional office in Vijayawada will cater to the banking and financial needs of the state, ensuring **better accessibility and operational efficiency** for stakeholders.
 
• The move is also aimed at strengthening the RBI's presence in **Andhra Pradesh**, which is an important state for agriculture, industry, and commerce.
 
• The inauguration was attended by top officials from the RBI and state government, emphasizing the importance of this development in fostering economic growth in the region.
